first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: crowd of spectators along the route
entities.identification: A group of multiple people behind the metal barriers on the left side of the track, excluding the separately registered people on the right.

entities.name: curved wooden ramp platform
entities.identification: The raised, closely spaced slatted riding surface on the outside of the left turn, with yellow, red, and white patterns on a gray-black background.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The first-person rider, whose black-sleeved arms and white gloves are visible, with red-and-black markings on the backs of the hands.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The bicycle controlled by Person B, with a visible black horizontal handlebar, black front wheel, and red front component.

entities.name: track surface
entities.identification: The gray-brown stone-granule paving on the inside of the turn and the narrow gray downhill slope between the residences after the exit.

entities.name: metal barriers along the route
entities.identification: The metal barrier panels arranged along the left side between the spectators and the riding passage.

entities.name: wall beside the track
entities.identification: The yellow-brown wall with red trim on the right side of the entrance, and the rough stone wall and light-colored wall section on the right side of the narrow slope after the exit.

entities.name: residential buildings along the route
entities.identification: The yellow-orange, reddish-brown, light-blue, and light-colored residences around the track, with balconies, doors and windows, and eaves locally visible.

entities.name: blue sky
entities.identification: The areas of blue sky visible above the buildings and vegetation.

entities.name: vegetation along the route
entities.identification: The dark- and light-green tree crowns, shrubs, and dense clusters of leaves near the residences and walls.

entities.name: strip of bare soil beside the road
entities.identification: The yellow-brown strip between the gray road surface after the exit and the base of the wall on the right.

entities.name: Person E
entities.identification: The person beside the wall on the right side of the ramp platform entrance, wearing a fluorescent yellow-green top, with the lower body in shadow.

entities.name: patterned ramp surface with a black background
entities.identification: The black ramp surface spanning the narrow road after the exit of the wooden ramp platform, with white and red text and yellow and red patterns.

entities.name: two-person group in red by the exit
entities.identification: The two people in red tops beside the exit wall; only one of them is visible in the early portion, and both are visible in frame 24.
